description: Add momentum confirmation filter requiring price above 50-day moving average to reduce whipsaws in sideways markets.
diff:
--- a/strategies/momentum.py
+++ b/strategies/momentum.py
@@ -7,6 +7,7 @@ import pandas as pd
 
 # Tunable parameter -- agent may modify this
 LOOKBACK_DAYS = 20
+TREND_FILTER_DAYS = 50
 
 
 def compute_signal(prices: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
@@ -18,11 +19,16 @@ def compute_signal(prices: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
     """
     returns = prices.pct_change()
     rolling_mean = returns.rolling(window=LOOKBACK_DAYS, min_periods=LOOKBACK_DAYS).mean()
+    
+    # Trend filter: price relative to longer-term moving average
+    price_ma = prices.rolling(window=TREND_FILTER_DAYS, min_periods=TREND_FILTER_DAYS).mean()
+    above_ma = prices > price_ma
 
     signal = rolling_mean.copy()
     signal[rolling_mean > 0] = 1
     signal[rolling_mean < 0] = -1
     signal[rolling_mean == 0] = 0
+    signal[(rolling_mean > 0) & (~above_ma)] = 0  # Cancel longs below trend
     signal = signal.fillna(0)
 
     return signal.shift(1).fillna(0)

description: Add momentum confirmation filter requiring price above 50-day moving average to reduce whipsaws in choppy markets.
diff:

+++ b/strategies/momentum.py
@@ -7,6 +7,7 @@ import pandas as pd
 
 # Tunable parameter -- agent may modify this
 LOOKBACK_DAYS = 20
+TREND_FILTER_DAYS = 50
 
 
 def compute_signal(prices: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:

     """
     returns = prices.pct_change()
     rolling_mean = returns.rolling(window=LOOKBACK_DAYS, min_periods=LOOKBACK_DAYS).mean()
+    trend_ma = prices.rolling(window=TREND_FILTER_DAYS, min_periods=TREND_FILTER_DAYS).mean()
 
     signal = rolling_mean.copy()
     signal[rolling_mean > 0] = 1
     signal[rolling_mean < 0] = -1
